purpose: Supplementary query-only timing for Chapter 7; not the historical runtime of the complete seed-plus-surrogate experiment.

procedure.profile_trials: Three consecutive stumpy.mass(q, x) calls, each timed with time.perf_counter().
procedure.match_trial: One subsequent stumpy.match(q, x, max_matches=200, max_distance=np.inf) call with STUMPY_EXCL_ZONE_DENOM=1/0.505 (the original spec exclusion), restored after the call.
excludes: all surrogate generation and surrogate searches

limitations: Three profile trials and one match-selection trial on one channel. This is a workstation timing check, not a speed guarantee, a benchmark over all 16 channels, or a measurement of the 200-draw null pipeline.
